LanguageData.LP_UH_GhoulXeno.label: ghoul
LanguageData.LP_UH_GhoulXeno.description: Corpse-eating undead: grey skin, skin and bones, no hair. Its claws carry a paralyzing corpse venom.
LanguageData.LP_UH_WightXeno.label: wight
LanguageData.LP_UH_WightXeno.description: An undead warrior that retains its skill from life: ash-grey skin and hair, able to draw the life force from the living with a single blow.
LanguageData.LP_UH_WraithXeno.label: wraith
LanguageData.LP_UH_WraithXeno.description: A wandering soul made only of resentment: an ink-black figure, semi-corporeal, that ordinary blades and guns can only half harm.
LanguageData.LP_UH_VampireXeno.label: vampire
LanguageData.LP_UH_VampireXeno.description: Ghastly pale skin and jet-black hair: blood-drinking undead aristocrats whose wounds heal on their own, fearing holy light, fire and sunlight.
